delivery.question: How long does delivery take?
delivery.answer_html: We deliver to your door within 10 business days. The shipping cost is shown in the cart and at checkout, before you pay. We ship to addresses in Israel only.
delivery.answer_free_html: We deliver to your door within 10 business days, and shipping is free on every order. We ship to addresses in Israel only.

returns.question: Can I return an item?
returns.answer_html: Yes, you can return items within 45 days. The full terms are in our returns policy.

sizing.question: How do I choose the right size?
sizing.answer_html: Check the size guide on the product page and compare it with a shirt that fits you well. Kids' items are sets of a jersey and shorts in sizes 16 to 28, for ages about 2 to 13, and the age is shown under each size. Kids' items are sold as separate products.

payment.question: How can I pay?
payment.answer_html: You can pay with any payment method shown at checkout. The checkout is secure.

team_orders.question: Do you take team orders?
team_orders.answer_html: Sure. Amateur teams, schools and clubs can order together, in adult and kids' sizes. Send us the quantities and sizes on the team orders page or on WhatsApp, and we'll get back to you with a quote.
team_orders.answer_no_whatsapp_html: Sure. Amateur teams, schools and clubs can order together, in adult and kids' sizes. Send us the quantities and sizes on the team orders page, and we'll get back to you with a quote.

printing.question: Can you print names and numbers?
printing.answer_html: Not at the moment. Our shirts are sold without name, number or patch printing.

size_guide.heading: Find your size
size_guide.text: Sizes can vary between brands and cuts. Use the chart below and compare it with a shirt that fits you well.
size_guide.adults_fallback: Each product's size chart is on its page, next to the size picker.
size_guide.kids_note: Kids' items are sets of a jersey and shorts, in sizes 16 to 28, for ages about 2 to 13. On each product page, the age is shown under each size. Choose by your child's height, and if they're between two sizes, choose the larger one.

measure.heading: How to measure
measure.intro: The charts measure the garment itself, not the body. The easiest way is to measure a shirt that fits well and compare it with the chart.

chest.title: Chest width
chest.text: Lay the shirt flat and measure straight across, from armpit to armpit.

length.title: Length
length.text: Measure from the highest point of the shoulder, next to the collar, straight down to the hem.

compare.title: Compare with the chart
compare.text: Choose the size closest to your shirt's measurements. If you're between two sizes, choose the larger one.
